summary.text: Rylee Linting is a Republican state representative from Michigan House District 27 who took office on January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Rylee Linting earned a high school diploma from Grosse Ile High School and attended Grand Valley State University and Liberty University.
Her career experience includes serving as the Motor City Field Representative for Turning Point Action, and she previously served as the Michigan Republican Party Youth Chair.
Linting assumed office in the Michigan House on January 1, 2025, and advanced from the Republican primary on August 4, 2026.
In the 2025-2026 session she is majority vice chair of the Education Committee and also sits on the Communications and Technology, Energy and House Regulatory Reform committees.
